description: This file defines the ClassSourcer class, which extends ASM's ClassVisitor to generate Java source code representations of Java classes by visiting class metadata, fields, methods, annotations, and other attributes.

classes.name: ClassSourcer
classes.description: A ASM ClassVisitor implementation that outputs Java source code representation of a class.

methods.name: visit
methods.description: Visits a class header and writes its package, class declaration, super class, and interfaces.

methods.name: visitEnd
methods.description: Completes the class source code output.

methods.name: visitAnnotation
methods.description: Visits an annotation and outputs its descriptor.

methods.name: visitField
methods.description: Visits a class field, skipping synthetic ones, and creates a FieldSourcer to handle its source output.

methods.name: visitMethod
methods.description: Visits a class method and returns a MethodSourcer to generate its stub.
